workboard_list.name: workboard_list
workboard_list.label: Workboard List
workboard_list.description: List Workboard cards with compact claim and diagnostic state. Use before choosing or routing board work.

workboard_create.name: workboard_create
workboard_create.label: Workboard Create
workboard_create.description: Create a Workboard card, optionally with parent dependencies, tenant, skills, workspace, and key to prevent duplicate requests. Sessions boards do not hold cards; use workboard_sessions_board_read/update/move for them.

token.description: Claim token for claimed parent cards.

createdByCardId.description: Parent card that created this card.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse this key when retrying to avoid creating a duplicate card.

branch.description: Optional worktree source base ref. Re-dispatch reuses a retained checkout; use a new card for a different base ref.

workboard_link.name: workboard_link
workboard_link.label: Workboard Link
workboard_link.description: Link a parent card to a child card so the child becomes ready only after parents are done.

token.description: Claim token for claimed parent or child cards.

workboard_read.name: workboard_read
workboard_read.label: Workboard Read
workboard_read.description: Read one Workboard card and return bounded worker context with notes, attempts, comments, proof, links, and diagnostics.

workboard_claim.name: workboard_claim
workboard_claim.label: Workboard Claim
workboard_claim.description: Claim a Workboard card for this agent and move backlog/todo cards into running. Returns a claim token for heartbeats and release.

workboard_heartbeat.name: workboard_heartbeat
workboard_heartbeat.label: Workboard Heartbeat
workboard_heartbeat.description: Refresh this agent's Workboard claim heartbeat. Use during long-running card work so diagnostics do not mark it stale.

workboard_release.name: workboard_release
workboard_release.label: Workboard Release
workboard_release.description: Release this agent's Workboard claim after finishing, pausing, or handing off card work.

status.description: Optional next card status after release.

workboard_comment.name: workboard_comment
workboard_comment.label: Workboard Comment
workboard_comment.description: Append a compact comment to a Workboard card.

workboard_proof.name: workboard_proof
workboard_proof.label: Workboard Proof
workboard_proof.description: Attach proof or artifact metadata to a Workboard card after running tests, checks, or producing screenshots/logs. Returns proofId; pass it to workboard_complete when that call reports the terminal status for this proof.

workboard_complete.name: workboard_complete
workboard_complete.label: Workboard Complete
workboard_complete.description: Complete a claimed Workboard card with a structured summary, proof, artifacts, and created-card manifest.

proofId.description: Proof id returned by workboard_proof when resolving that pending proof.

workboard_attachment_add.name: workboard_attachment_add
workboard_attachment_add.label: Workboard Attachment Add
workboard_attachment_add.description: Store a small Workboard attachment in plugin SQLite KV and link it to the card.

workboard_attachment_read.name: workboard_attachment_read
workboard_attachment_read.label: Workboard Attachment Read
workboard_attachment_read.description: Read one Workboard attachment from plugin SQLite KV.

workboard_attachment_delete.name: workboard_attachment_delete
workboard_attachment_delete.label: Workboard Attachment Delete
workboard_attachment_delete.description: Delete one Workboard attachment from plugin SQLite KV and the card index.

workboard_block.name: workboard_block
workboard_block.label: Workboard Block
workboard_block.description: Block a claimed Workboard card with a durable reason and release the claim.

workboard_unblock.name: workboard_unblock
workboard_unblock.label: Workboard Unblock
workboard_unblock.description: Move a blocked Workboard card back to todo after adding enough context.

workboard_move.name: workboard_move
workboard_move.label: Workboard Move
workboard_move.description: Move a Workboard card to another status. Claimed cards require matching claim scope.

workboard_boards.name: workboard_boards
workboard_boards.label: Workboard Boards
workboard_boards.description: List Workboard board namespaces with active, archived, and status counts.

workboard_board_create.name: workboard_board_create
workboard_board_create.label: Workboard Board Create
workboard_board_create.description: Create or update a Workboard board with persisted SQLite metadata. Choose kind sessions on creation for columns with rules over Gateway-owned session facts; card tools do not apply to Sessions boards. Board kind cannot change after creation.

kind.description: Board kind, set only at creation. Default cards.

branch.description: Optional worktree source base ref. Re-dispatch reuses a retained checkout; use a new card for a different base ref.

autoDecompose.description: Mark ready triage cards for decomposition.

workboard_board_archive.name: workboard_board_archive
workboard_board_archive.label: Workboard Board Archive
workboard_board_archive.description: Archive or restore persisted Workboard board metadata.

workboard_board_delete.name: workboard_board_delete
workboard_board_delete.label: Workboard Board Delete
workboard_board_delete.description: Delete an empty non-default Workboard board metadata record.

workboard_stats.name: workboard_stats
workboard_stats.label: Workboard Stats
workboard_stats.description: Summarize Workboard counts by status and assignee for one board or all boards.

workboard_runs.name: workboard_runs
workboard_runs.label: Workboard Runs
workboard_runs.description: List persisted Workboard run attempts for one card.

workboard_specify.name: workboard_specify
workboard_specify.label: Workboard Specify
workboard_specify.description: Turn a rough triage/backlog Workboard card into a specified todo card after reasoning through the requirements.

branch.description: Optional worktree source base ref. Re-dispatch reuses a retained checkout; use a new card for a different base ref.

workboard_decompose.name: workboard_decompose
workboard_decompose.label: Workboard Decompose
workboard_decompose.description: Fan out a Workboard card into linked child cards and optionally complete the parent orchestration card.

completeParent.description: Complete the parent after child creation. Default true.

branch.description: Optional worktree source base ref. Re-dispatch reuses a retained checkout; use a new card for a different base ref.

workboard_notify_subscribe.name: workboard_notify_subscribe
workboard_notify_subscribe.label: Workboard Notify Subscribe
workboard_notify_subscribe.description: Persist a Workboard notification subscription in the plugin SQLite store.

workboard_notify_events.name: workboard_notify_events
workboard_notify_events.label: Workboard Notify Events
workboard_notify_events.description: Read replay-safe Workboard notification events without advancing cursors.

workboard_notify_advance.name: workboard_notify_advance
workboard_notify_advance.label: Workboard Notify Advance
workboard_notify_advance.description: Read Workboard notification events and advance the subscription cursor.

workboard_notify_unsubscribe.name: workboard_notify_unsubscribe
workboard_notify_unsubscribe.label: Workboard Notify Unsubscribe
workboard_notify_unsubscribe.description: Delete a persisted Workboard notification subscription.

workboard_promote.name: workboard_promote
workboard_promote.label: Workboard Promote
workboard_promote.description: Promote a todo card into ready, optionally forcing past dependency or schedule holds. Unblock blocked cards first.

workboard_reassign.name: workboard_reassign
workboard_reassign.label: Workboard Reassign
workboard_reassign.description: Change a card assignee and optionally reset failure state during recovery.

workboard_reclaim.name: workboard_reclaim
workboard_reclaim.label: Workboard Reclaim
workboard_reclaim.description: Release a stale claim and stop running attempts so another agent can pick it up.

workboard_dispatch.name: workboard_dispatch
workboard_dispatch.label: Workboard Dispatch
workboard_dispatch.description: Advance persisted board state without launching workers: promote unblocked cards, reclaim expired claims, and block timed-out runs.

workboard_worker_log.name: workboard_worker_log
workboard_worker_log.label: Workboard Worker Log
workboard_worker_log.description: Append a persisted worker log entry to a Workboard card.

workboard_protocol_violation.name: workboard_protocol_violation
workboard_protocol_violation.label: Workboard Protocol Violation
workboard_protocol_violation.description: Block a card and record a worker protocol violation when work stops without complete/block.

workboard_sessions_board_read.name: workboard_sessions_board_read
workboard_sessions_board_read.label: Sessions Board Read
workboard_sessions_board_read.description: Read a Sessions board and its session placements. Columns match Gateway-owned session status, observer health, and pull-request facts in order; operator pins take precedence. Card tools do not apply to Sessions boards.

boardId.description: Board id. May be omitted only when exactly one Sessions board exists.

workboard_sessions_board_update.name: workboard_sessions_board_update
workboard_sessions_board_update.label: Sessions Board Update
workboard_sessions_board_update.description: Edit a Sessions board's columns, match rules, or scope. columns replaces the full ordered list; preserve ids when renaming labels. All fields in each rule must match; a match array accepts any rule, and the first matching column wins. Exactly one fallback is required. Card tools do not apply to Sessions boards.

boardId.description: Board id. May be omitted only when exactly one Sessions board exists.

id.description: Stable column id. Keep this id when renaming the label.

color.description: red, blue, green, yellow, purple, orange, pink, or cyan.

description.description: Description shown in the column tooltip.

fallback.description: Exactly one column must be the unresolved-session fallback.

includeAutomation.description: Include automation (cron) and system sessions. Defaults to false.

includeHome.description: Include each agent's Home session. Defaults to false.

workboard_sessions_board_move.name: workboard_sessions_board_move
workboard_sessions_board_move.label: Sessions Board Move
workboard_sessions_board_move.description: Pin a session in a Sessions board column. The pin overrides match rules while the column exists. Card tools do not apply to Sessions boards.

boardId.description: Board id. May be omitted only when exactly one Sessions board exists.

sessionKey.description: Exact session key from the board read.

columnId.description: Destination column id from the board read.
